eligibility: run if and only if Day 54 implementation passes and either reciprocal scientific gate fails
evidence_class: result-contingent new interventions on the unchanged 26-example development sandbox
hypothesis: if exact selected donor K12 is not self-contained, donor-like downstream identity may require interaction with the donor response residual entering layer 9

k12.target: exact natural target activity at all 12 selected raw heads
k12.donor: exact natural donor activity at all 12 selected raw heads

response_context.target: exact natural target response rows at resid_pre[9]
response_context.donor: exact natural donor response rows at resid_pre[9]

matched_controls.haar_k12: per-head Haar rotation of the target-to-donor K12 delta with base seed 55101 and draw index 0
matched_controls.haar_context: signed coordinate permutation of the target-to-donor resid_pre[9] response delta with seed 55102

primary_estimands.joint_donor_recovery: projection of donor_context.donor_k12 minus target_context.target_k12 onto the exact natural donor-minus-target endpoint

interpretive_gate.context_interaction_supported: joint complete-probe donor recovery at least 0.70, joint probe donor-nearest in at least 10 of 13 concepts in both directions, and either median recovery exceeds target-context donor-K12 by at least 0.25 or donor-nearest count improves by at least two concepts; joint also beats both Haar controls by at least 0.25
interpretive_gate.minimal_context_insufficient: the context-interaction gate fails in either direction
interpretive_gate.boundary: a pass identifies a layer-9 response-context interaction, not a compact endogenous controller; a fail excludes only this minimal context factor

forbidden: changing the residual-context boundary after outcomes
